events.title: Hearst Award Ceremony: Camille Zapata
events.address: One Washington Square, San José, CA 95192
events.description: Join us for the presentation of the Hearst Award to Camille Zapata, in recognition of her achievements in relation to the First Amendment and her influential role in the changing media landscape.
events.attendanceNote: Food begins at 4 PM; the award ceremony begins at 4:30 PM. Admission is free and open to all; RSVP through SJSU's linked form.
events.blurb: Watch the presentation of the Hearst Award to Camille Zapata, honored for her First Amendment achievements and her role in changing media.

events.title: SJSU Art Galleries Tuesday Night Lecture: Ryan Carrington
events.address: One Washington Square, San José, CA 95192
events.description: An acclaimed weekly lecture series brings in artists, designers, and critical theorists from around the world, broadening the students' experiential base and complementing local offerings.
events.blurb: Hear Ryan Carrington speak in the weekly Tuesday night art lecture series that brings artists, designers and critical theorists to campus.

events.title: Third Annual Running in Prayer Run & Prayer Circle
events.description: Location: Tower Lawn. Join the 500 Mile Runners for a run (or walk) and prayer circle. All are welcome. The American Indian Movement authorizes this annual run and continues to support it.
events.blurb: Run or walk with the 500 Mile Runners on Tower Lawn, then gather for a prayer circle open to everyone.

events.title: Dan and Phil: Hard Launch World Tour
events.address: 135 West San Carlos Street, San Jose, CA 95113
events.description: Dan and Phil finally hard launched and are crash landing in a city near you.
events.blurb: Hear Dan and Phil riff live on stage as their Hard Launch tour lands at San Jose Civic.

events.blurb: Watch Mexican actor and comedian Adrián Uribe perform live at San Jose Civic.
